BUSINESS STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   C. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

5. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   B. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.
   D. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   C. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

11. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   C. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.

12. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   C. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   C. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   D. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   D. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   C. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Insurance as rumours only.

16. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   B. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   C. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Networking in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Income Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Statement of Financial Position and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Cash Flow Statement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
